<documents>
<document id="wires-incoming">
ReceivingˆaˆwireˆYouˆcanˆreceiveˆdomesticˆandˆinternationalˆwiresˆintoˆyourˆTallowbrookˆaccountˆonˆanyˆplan.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆgiveˆtheˆsenderˆYourˆroutingˆnumber,ˆaccountˆnumber,ˆfullˆlegalˆnameˆandˆaddressˆareˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆAccountˆdetails,ˆthenˆWireˆinstructions.ˆInternationalˆsendersˆalsoˆneedˆourˆSWIFTˆcode,ˆshownˆonˆtheˆsameˆscreen.ˆ##ˆFeesˆ|ˆPlanˆ|ˆIncomingˆdomesticˆwireˆ|ˆIncomingˆinternationalˆwireˆ|ˆ|---|---|---|ˆ|ˆBasicˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆ$10.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆPlusˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆ$10.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆPremiumˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆ##ˆTimingˆDomesticˆwiresˆusuallyˆarriveˆwithinˆhoursˆonˆaˆbusinessˆday.ˆInternationalˆwiresˆcanˆtakeˆlonger,ˆdependingˆonˆtheˆsendingˆbank.ˆ##ˆIfˆaˆwireˆhasn'tˆarrivedˆAskˆtheˆsenderˆforˆtheˆwireˆreferenceˆnumberˆandˆtheˆdateˆitˆwasˆsent,ˆthenˆmessageˆsupport.ˆWiresˆwithˆaˆnameˆthatˆdoesn'tˆmatchˆyourˆaccountˆnameˆmayˆbeˆreturnedˆtoˆtheˆsender.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="wires-basic">
WireˆfeesˆonˆBasicˆHere'sˆwhatˆwiresˆcostˆonˆtheˆBasicˆplan.ˆ|ˆWireˆ|ˆFeeˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆOutgoingˆdomesticˆ|ˆ$25.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆOutgoingˆinternationalˆ|ˆnotˆavailableˆ|ˆ|ˆIncomingˆdomesticˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆ|ˆIncomingˆinternationalˆ|ˆ$10.00ˆ|ˆYouˆcanˆsendˆupˆtoˆ$5,000ˆaˆdayˆinˆdomesticˆwiresˆonˆBasic.ˆ##ˆCutoffˆtimesˆDomesticˆwiresˆsentˆbeforeˆ3:00ˆPMˆETˆonˆaˆbusinessˆdayˆgoˆoutˆtheˆsameˆday.ˆToˆsendˆmoneyˆabroadˆbyˆwire,ˆyou'dˆneedˆtoˆmoveˆtoˆPlusˆorˆPremium.ˆYouˆcanˆstillˆreceiveˆinternationalˆwiresˆonˆBasic.ˆ##ˆBeforeˆyouˆsendˆWiresˆcan'tˆbeˆcancelledˆonceˆthey'reˆsent.ˆCheckˆtheˆrecipient'sˆname,ˆbankˆandˆaccountˆnumberˆcarefully.ˆBeˆwaryˆofˆanyoneˆwhoˆpressuresˆyouˆtoˆwireˆmoneyˆquickly,ˆespeciallyˆsomeoneˆyou'veˆonlyˆmetˆonline.ˆOtherˆbanksˆinvolvedˆinˆtheˆwireˆmayˆchargeˆtheirˆownˆfees,ˆwhichˆcanˆreduceˆtheˆamountˆtheˆrecipientˆgets.ˆWeˆshowˆourˆfeeˆbeforeˆyouˆconfirm.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="wires-domestic">
SendingˆaˆdomesticˆwireˆDomesticˆwiresˆsendˆmoneyˆtoˆanotherˆUSˆbankˆaccountˆonˆtheˆsameˆbusinessˆday.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆsendˆaˆwireˆ1.ˆTapˆTransfers,ˆthenˆWire.ˆ2.ˆEnterˆtheˆrecipient'sˆname,ˆbankˆroutingˆnumber,ˆaccountˆnumberˆandˆaddress.ˆ3.ˆReviewˆtheˆfeeˆandˆconfirmˆwithˆyourˆpasscode.ˆ##ˆCutoffˆWiresˆsubmittedˆbeforeˆ3:00ˆPMˆETˆonˆaˆbusinessˆdayˆareˆsentˆtheˆsameˆday.ˆLaterˆwiresˆareˆsentˆtheˆnextˆbusinessˆday.ˆ##ˆFeesˆandˆlimitsˆ|ˆPlanˆ|ˆFeeˆ|ˆDailyˆlimitˆ|ˆ|---|---|---|ˆ|ˆBasicˆ|ˆ$25.00ˆ|ˆ$5,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆPlusˆ|ˆ$15.00ˆ|ˆ$10,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆPremiumˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆ$25,000ˆ|ˆ##ˆBeforeˆyouˆsendˆWiresˆcan'tˆbeˆcancelledˆonceˆsent.ˆDouble-checkˆtheˆdetails,ˆandˆbeˆcarefulˆifˆsomeoneˆyou'veˆonlyˆmetˆonline,ˆorˆsomeoneˆclaimingˆtoˆbeˆfromˆaˆbankˆorˆtheˆgovernment,ˆasksˆyouˆtoˆwireˆmoney.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>

Customer question: How much does sending a domestic wire cost on each plan?
